Entities cross-checked against seed: M-11 'Pryce lease dispute' 7-day, M-12 'Marsh Holdings acquisition' off/walled Dev, M-13 'Pryce will' 30-day; quoted messages and dates are exact (K-1 1 May unheld so expired; K-10 05-05T11:00:00 exactly 7 days vs K-11 +1 s; K-13 4 May with version 'Probate estimate is 2,400 pounds.'; K-18 3 May; K-7 held; K-17 held 3 May; K-2 held with version 'Landlords notice recieved.'; K-3 2026-05-08T15:00; K-8, K-6 'heads of terms', K-5 'Fenwick'; K-16 'Schedule 2'); arithmetic claims ('eight-day-old', 'nine days ago', 'exactly seven days') hold against clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z. Mention-suggestion expectations (M-12: Sian, Paul, never Dev/Gwen; M-11: Dev, Sian, Gwen, never Paul) follow the seed visibility rules. Deliverable/URL/clock (localhost:3000, fixed 11:00 UTC) consistent with integration.md. Functional prompt's 'Each session grades one criterion ... in the listed order' matches judge.toml mode='individual'; polish/visual 'Task state' sections correctly note the post-functional state, and visual targets (held K-7 in M-13, nested replies in M-13, M-11 transcript) survive the functional sequence. Grep for sibling residue (hireops, colderwater, threadline/channel, candidate, ticket, tenant, invoice, etc.) found none; 'empty workspace' is verbatim frozen template boilerplate. Corroboration: the scripted golden run on matching source hashes passed all 16 functional criteria, constraints gate steps and six polish criteria using these same seed facts (scripted Playwright, not a judge run). Attempted counterexamples: a sibling-copied account list or wrong matter/title would be caught by the above cross-check and none exists; a conforming app that hides edit/delete for non-authors is not penalised since app_context's control list is descriptive and no criterion requires those controls on others' messages.
